subject: MAP: Eval gating & reservation — GPU pool risk mitigation
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@pioneerdx.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, procurement@pioneerdx.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff — eval plan + reservation lead times

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. PioneerDx is ready to move from PoC to a scoped eval across our clinical inference pipelines, but we need to align on a few schedule and procurement constraints before we commit to a reservation. Key asks from our side: 

- A clear MAP (milestones with dates) showing Eval start, Perf gates, Acceptance, and Reservation cutover.
- Concrete GPU lead-time estimates for Dedicated and Private options (worst/typical).
- An outline of the minimum pool sizing we should reserve to meet 95th percentile latency targets (our target: 300ms p50 for 2k qps burst).
- Any commercial signals required to lock capacity (deposit, term, invoice cadence).

I've attached our Eval requirements doc and a preliminary SOW template. Procurement (procurement@pioneerdx.com) is on copy — they want a not-to-exceed date for capacity delivery so they can coordinate internal approvals.

Can you map out a proposed MAP and call out where Redwood would expect procurement signoff vs. technical acceptance?

Appreciate it —
Alex
Alex Chen
Head of ML Engineering | Pioneer Diagnostics
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@pioneerdx.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — eval plan + reservation lead times

Alex —

Great to see the clear asks — thanks for sending the requirements. I sketched a pragmatic MAP below that separates the Eval gating (technical) from the commercial Reservation milestones. We can compress some steps if PioneerDx is willing to accept a staged reservation (partial pool at acceptance, remaining capacity on fixed lead time).

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Eval kickoff (Week 0): data onboarding, small-scale smoke tests (no reservation) — target start: 2026-11-02
2) Perf validation (Week 2–4): run 1M tokens/day perf sweep; target gates: p50 latency < 350ms on 2k qps sim and qualitative accuracy checks
3) Acceptance sprint (Week 5): customer sign-off on perf tests + security checklist (SOC2 evidence & network proof)
4) Reservation commit (Week 6): commercial PO submitted -> Redwood reserves GPU tranche (partial or full)
5) Delivery & onboarding (lead time window): dependent on Dedicated vs Private. See estimates below.

Lead-time guidance (typical / worst-case) for planning:
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity in our cloud pools): typical 4–6 weeks, worst-case 9–12 weeks (depends on pool availability & tranche size)
- Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem): typical 8–12 weeks, worst-case 16–20 weeks (networking and KMS/HSM integration are the main drivers)

Minimum pool sizing (initial suggested tranche):
- For your 2k qps burst profile with 300ms p50 target, we recommend reserving a tranche sized for sustained 1.2k qps with burst headroom (this maps to ~24 A100-equivalent vGPUs at q8.quantized profiles).
- If you require stricter latency at full 2k qps, plan for 36 A100-equivalent vGPUs.

Next steps I propose:
- Karthik (SE) to confirm the detailed model/quantization mappings and acceptance criteria.
- Marissa (Onboarding) to capture procurement triggers and milestone invoices.
- I will draft a MAP document with dates and a suggested staggered reservation path (partial commit at acceptance, remaining commit on fixed calendar date).

I'll attach the MAP draft and a capacity schedule spreadsheet for your review. If PioneerDx’s procurement needs a firm delivery-by date for approvals, we can propose hard windows based on the worst-case lead times above.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@pioneerdx.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — eval plan + reservation lead times

Alex / Aisha —

Quick technical clarifications and acceptance gates so the Eval team knows what to measure: 

- Test model: production variant (llama-3-style) + quantized q8 profile; we will provide a compatible checkpoint or model pin during Eval.
- Data shape: 512 token avg, worst-case 1024 token sequences for long-tail tests.
- Perf gates: p50 latency < 350ms, p95 < 900ms under 2k qps synthetic burst; tail-latency targets vary with batch window but we'll provide a synthetic harness to reproduce.
- KV/prefix caching: enable prefix caching for stable sequences to reduce token compute during Eval. We'll instrument cache hit rates in the MAP telemetry dashboard.
- Acceptance artifacts: perf report, trace logs, KV cache hit summary, and a checklist that includes SOC2 evidence pointers.

Sizing rationale: the 24 A100-equivalent tranche assumes q8 quantization with continuous batching optimized for your traffic profile; if PioneerDx prefers fp16 for accuracy reasons, the recommended tranche increases ~40%.

Operational notes: for Dedicated we can provision a soft tranche quickly but ask for a minimum 30% deposit to prioritize allocation during high-demand windows. For Private, networking (VPC peering / firewall rules) and KMS are the longest poles — we typically need your networking team to sign off within 5 business days of Acceptance to stay on the 8–12 week window.

I'll add a short acceptance checklist to the MAP doc and include the synthetic harness link.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@pioneerdx.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — eval plan + reservation lead times

Alex / team —

From a procurement & onboarding perspective, here's a concise commercial workflow that aligns with Aisha/Karthik's proposed MAP: 

Milestone commercial triggers:
- Eval kickoff: no commercial commitment (redwood covers initial platform access for 2 weeks)
- Acceptance: PioneerDx issues PO covering the first tranche (invoice schedule: 30% deposit within 7 days of PO, 70% on tranche activation)
- Staged reservation: optional second tranche PO submitted with 60-day lead calendar (if you want hard delivery date)

Contract pointers:
- Term: typical 12–24 months for Reserved pools; discounts scale with term & committed vGPU hours.
- Credits & SLAs: we can include a 45-day SLA ramp for newly provisioned Private deployments.
- Cancellation: partial-tranche refunds on pro-rata basis after invoice windows, but hardware procurement costs are non-refundable in the first 90 days.

I'll prepare marked-up commercial language for the MAP and the PO template. Ben, can you confirm the discount band for a staged 36-vGPU commit at 12-month term?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@pioneerdx.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@pioneerdx.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — eval plan + reservation lead times

Aisha / team —

This is helpful — thank you. PioneerDx can start the Eval kickoff on 2026-11-02 and we'll target Acceptance by 2026-12-07 (gives us two weeks of internal sign-off). Procurement wants the worst-case delivery date for the full Private deployment so we can secure budget approvals — please use the 20-week worst-case you referenced and we will factor that into our calendar.

I'll review the MAP draft in Drive and route the PO for the first tranche pending the Eval acceptance report.

Best,
Alex
